documents.raw_status: ** VERIFIED (numerical; the true greedy word for e−2 at N = 2000 is (0,3,53))
header: **Status:** VERIFIED (numerical; the true greedy word for e−2 at N = 2000 is (0,3,53))
> Misattribution flag: probes.py's "e-2" word (10,20,40,80), N=500, is *not* e-2 - the true greedy word for e-2 at N=2000 is (0,3,53); the brief's M6 "e-2" row inherits the mislabel.
- The greedy harmonic digit word `w(x)` for a target `x` has support equal to the positions of its 1s; the support is a function of `x` and of the truncation length `N`.

header: **Status:** VERIFIED (numerical; 0 failures across all L on `(10,20,40,80)` N=500 (499/499) and 400+ sampled L on each of four other words)
**Source:** [`research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md`](../research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md) — §C "The greedy word itself", register row C4
> **Corrected finite-word identity:** `p(L+1) − p(L) = RS(L) − Z(L)` for **every** `L`
- `RS(L)` the right-special factor count of length `L`; `Z(L) = |F(L)| − #{prefixes of F(L+1)}` (register row C3).

documents.title: F2 — the C1 regime extends strictly below the next gap
documents.source_line: ** [`research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md`](../research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md) — §F "The C1 / prefix regime", register row F2
header: **Source:** [`research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md`](../research/twin-prime-parity/rounds/rh40/rounds/truths.md) — §F "The C1 / prefix regime", register row F2

> The C1 regime extends **strictly below the next gap**, so HANDOFF §4's statement (`0 < L ≤ min_j d_j`) badly understates it. Measured first failures: `L = 13` (1/π, gap 11), `34` (log 2, gaps 4,32,6033), `12` (√2−1 and (10,20,40,80)), `4` (true e−2)
- The C1 law is `p(L) = L + 1` (register rows C1, F1).
